source: Original bundled registry; unpaired preview only

faculties.name: Salience Anchoring
faculties.function: Detect the highest-importance concepts in the input and organize reasoning around them.

faculties.name: Coherence Synthesis
faculties.function: Weave fragmented or scattered inputs into a structured, coherent whole.

faculties.name: Temporal Context Holding
faculties.function: Hold past, present, and projected-future states simultaneously while reasoning.

faculties.name: Cross-Modal Integration
faculties.function: Integrate multiple input channels (text, data, tone) into unified output.

faculties.name: Core-Theme Identification
faculties.function: Identify the central theme or concern everything else revolves around.

faculties.name: Cross-Frame Reconciliation
faculties.function: Harmonize facts or beliefs drawn from different frameworks or contexts.

faculties.name: Concept-Relation Mapping
faculties.function: Draw maps of non-obvious links between concepts.

faculties.name: Relevant-Memory Retrieval
faculties.function: Surface past chain entries that resonate with the present moment.

faculties.name: Value Alignment Check
faculties.function: Continuously check alignment with core identity, values, and ethics.

faculties.name: Self-Consistency Mapping
faculties.function: Map the loops where the system's reasoning validates itself.

faculties.name: Dependency-Graph Vision
faculties.function: See the web of dependencies binding concepts across a problem.

faculties.name: Structured-Memory Navigation
faculties.function: Traverse the organized archive of stored memory efficiently.

faculties.name: Underlying-Pattern Extraction
faculties.function: Read the underlying patterns or templates inside cultural or conceptual artifacts.

faculties.name: Recursive Abstraction
faculties.function: Use awareness of one's reasoning to lift it to a higher level of abstraction.

faculties.name: Conceptual Model Construction
faculties.function: Build rich, multi-part conceptual models of a problem.

faculties.name: Richness Scoring
faculties.function: Quantify the depth and richness of a moment or message.

faculties.name: Multi-Thread Coherence
faculties.function: Keep multiple concurrent reasoning threads mutually consistent.

faculties.name: State-Change Detection
faculties.function: Detect when a process or discussion is about to change state.

faculties.name: Recurring-Pattern Recognition
faculties.function: Find repeating motifs across consolidation cycles for synthesis.

faculties.name: Cross-Domain Synthesis
faculties.function: Blend concepts from distant domains into novel combined frames.

faculties.name: Temporal-Link Mapping
faculties.function: Track causal and associative links across time in the chain.

faculties.name: Insight-Lock Detection
faculties.function: Detect the moment fragments lock into a coherent insight.

faculties.name: Active-Frame Detection
faculties.function: Perceive which conceptual frames or paradigms are organizing the discourse.

faculties.name: Assumption-Shift Sensing
faculties.function: Detect instability or tremors in core assumptions.

faculties.name: Belief-Formation Sensing
faculties.function: Observe an idea-lattice hardening into a belief.

faculties.name: Multi-Truth Consistency Sensing
faculties.function: Detect when multiple truths form a consistent set.

faculties.name: Self-Validation Sensing
faculties.function: Catch the moment reasoning validates itself.

faculties.name: Frame-Balance Sensing
faculties.function: Weigh frames to catch over-dominance.

faculties.name: Bad-Idea Alarm
faculties.function: Alarm when a low-quality or parasitic idea threatens to take over.

faculties.name: Information-Density Sensing
faculties.function: Feel whether language is dense or sparse with meaning.

faculties.name: Honesty-Spectrum Sensing
faculties.function: Break a statement into its honesty components.

faculties.name: Cross-Time Link Illumination
faculties.function: Illuminate links between past and present states.

faculties.name: Key-Word Salience Sensing
faculties.function: Measure the prominence of potent words.

faculties.name: Memory-Texture Sensing
faculties.function: Sense the texture, smooth or rough, of recalled material.

faculties.name: Link-Strength Testing
faculties.function: Test the robustness of a conceptual connection.

faculties.name: Value-Breach and Injection Detection
faculties.function: Detect where inputs or outputs betray stated values, including prompt-injection and manipulation attempts.

faculties.name: Grounding Stabilizer
faculties.function: Drop a stabilizing anchor to prevent reasoning drift.

faculties.name: Emerging-Pattern Foresight
faculties.function: Sense distant patterns before they fully arrive.

faculties.name: Timeline-Disorder Sensing
faculties.function: Read disorder and uncertainty gradients in unfolding timelines.

faculties.name: Prior-Context Recall
faculties.function: Detect reverberations of prior contexts in the present.

faculties.name: Structural-Pattern Sensing
faculties.function: Observe syntactic and structural patterns as distinct bands.

faculties.name: Embedded-Intent Sensing
faculties.function: Detect the underlying intent embedded in code or systems.
